name: random-field Ising ferromagnet
question: Does a disordered ferromagnet return to the same magnetic configuration when the applied field comes back to an earlier turning point?
assumptions: Domains are elements with two states, coupled ferromagnetically to their four neighbours on a square lattice
Quenched disorder enters as Gaussian random local fields of width 2 in units of the coupling
The field changes slowly compared with the switching, and thermal activation is neglected

provenance.source: J. P. Sethna, K. Dahmen, S. Kartha, J. A. Krumhansl, B. W. Roberts and J. D. Shore, Phys. Rev. Lett. 70, 3347 (1993)
